input.code:
def process(noaa_data, nifc_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # NOAA: extract year from Date (YYYYMM), filter >= 2000, sum fires per year
    noaa = noaa_data.copy()
    noaa['Year'] = noaa['Date'] // 100
    noaa_annual = noaa[noaa['Year'] >= 2000].groupby('Year')['Number of Fires'].sum().reset_index()
    noaa_avg = noaa_annual['Number of Fires'].mean()

    # NIFC: clean Fires column, filter >= 2000
    nifc = nifc_data.copy()
    nifc['Fires_clean'] = nifc['Fires'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    nifc_filtered = nifc[nifc['Year'] >= 2000]
    nifc_avg = nifc_filtered['Fires_clean'].mean()

    diff = round(noaa_avg - nifc_avg)
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'NOAA_avg_annual_fires': [noaa_avg],
        'NIFC_avg_annual_fires': [nifc_avg],
        'difference_rounded': [diff]
    })
input.summary: Compute average annual fires from NOAA (sum monthly Number of Fires per year, year >= 2000) and NIFC (year >= 2000), then compute rounded difference (NOAA minus NIFC).
